§5Vestige Power§7 - represents how much of the Vestige’s original abilities are currently active. 
In most cases, this value does not affect the Vestige's abilities description. 
By default, Vestige Power starts at 10%. 
Completing new Challenges increases it by 5%, and obtaining Stellar grants an additional 10%. 
Vestige Power can reach up to 100%, and all values can be customized in the config for each Vestige.
